	end

        task.wait(1)
        TodoService.RE.RightActivated:FireServer(nil)
        task.wait(0.4)
        BruteForceService.RE.Activated:FireServer(bruteForceMove)
        task.wait(0.75)
        BruteForceService.RE.Activated:FireServer(bruteForceMove)
    end
end

SetupGUI()

    task.wait(0.5)
    SetupGUI()
